identity.name: Rishika Kapoor
identity.bio: Crafting evocative visual identities, editorial campaigns, and cinematic brand narratives for luxury lifestyle and fashion houses across Mumbai, Paris, and London.

content.about: With over 8 years of directing high-impact visual campaigns, my work sits at the intersection of classical portraiture and modern digital surrealism. I collaborate directly with visionary founders, global editorial desks, and haute couture labels to translate tactile texture into digital resonance.

services.title: Editorial & Lookbook Direction
services.description: End-to-end creative direction, casting, location scouting, and lighting architecture for seasonal runway and retail launches.

services.title: Brand Visual Identity & Rebranding
services.description: Holistic visual systems, palette development, typographic hierarchy, and brand imagery guidelines for luxury brands.

services.title: Cinematic Micro-Films & Social Campaigns
services.description: Short-form 4K vertical film capsules tailored for Instagram Reels, digital billboards, and omnichannel activations.

experience.description: Directing monthly cover stories and digital feature spreads for premier fashion editions.
Executed high-jewelry and couture campaigns for international luxury houses.
Exhibited solo photography series in Milan, Tokyo, and Mumbai.

projects.title: Aura of Silence: Winter Couture

projects.title: Solstice Light: High Jewelry Capsule

projects.title: Desert Mirage: Monolith Series
projects.subtitle: Commercial Brand Narrative for Nomad Atelier
projects.description: Shot on location across the sand dunes of Jaisalmer, celebrating handwoven raw silk and earthy indigo dyes.

achievements.title: Over 120M Organic Social Impressions
achievements.detail: Directed viral campaign films featured globally across TikTok and Instagram.

testimonials.quote: Rishika possesses that exceedingly rare gift of turning an abstract moodboard into an unforgettable editorial reality. Her eye for light and composition redefined our brand.
Working with Rishika was the smoothest production experience of my career. The campaign exceeded our retail sell-through targets within the first 48 hours.

process.title: Creative Consultation & Discovery
process.description: Aligning on core brand DNA, audience psychology, moodboard curation, and narrative objectives.

process.title: Production Design & Pre-Visualization
process.description: Comprehensive call sheets, location scouting, talent casting, and lighting test diagrams.

process.title: Execution & Set Direction
process.description: Shooting tethered with real-time digital monitoring and collaborative client review on set.

process.title: Bespoke Color Grading & Delivery
process.description: Precision retouching, print-ready color profiles, and multi-format web-optimized assets delivered in 4K.
